services.name: Drive-up units
services.blurb: Roll-up doors for shutters, generators, patio sets and beach gear.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Every April we fly back to Ohio and the Buick and the golf cart go to Boyd's place. We come home in November, the battery tender is still on, and the car starts on the first try.
reviews.name: Wilhelmina J.

reviews.text: Our HOA in Palm Harbor sent the letter about the boat in the driveway. Got a covered space here that week. Twelve minutes from the house, and the boat lane at the gate is wide enough for my 22-footer without a three-point turn.
reviews.name: Augustin N.

reviews.text: We gutted the kitchen of our condo on the beach for six weeks. All the furniture and two paintings sat in a climate unit and came back without a spot of mildew.
reviews.name: Ottilie G.

reviews.text: When the storm watch came in September we finally had room in the garage for the car, because the shutters, the generator and the patio set live here now.
reviews.name: Fitzgerald M.

reviews.text: A locker for rods, tackle and the cast net, so my truck doesn't smell like bait anymore. I swing by before sunrise on the way to the causeway.
reviews.name: Leopold C.

reviews.text: Nice people and fair prices. The office closes early on Saturday which caught me once, but the gate code still worked and I got my things.
reviews.name: Henrietta A.

proof.guarantee: Leave before your month ends and we refund the unused days. No move-out fee, ever.

prices.note: up to 30 ft on the trailer
